newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May minivehicle sales down 14.9% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan May minivehicle sales down 14.9% yr/yr.

text.p: The Japan Mini Vehicle Association said on Thursday that domestic sales of minivehicles -- those with engines up to 660 cc -- fell 14.9 percent in May from a year earlier to 109,058 units.
The May decline, the second successive month of falls, resulted mainly from the impact of a sales tax increase in April, it said.

The jump in Honda's sales was a result of strong demand for its new Life multi-purpose vehicle, which was introduced on April 27.
Honda set a monthly sales target of 8,000 units for the Life, but said in May that it received about 30,000 orders in the first month after the vehicle was launched.
It was the first time in almost four years that Honda's monthly minicar sales had surpassed those of Mitsubishi.
